test_simple_word_tokenizer_vocabulary: test a custom tokenizer to verify its internal vocabulary matches the expected token list
test_simple_word_tokenizer_encode_decode: test a custom tokenizer to ensure encoding then decoding a sentence returns the original text
test_simple_word_tokenizer_roundtrip: test a tokenizer encode and decode roundtrip using a training dataset sentence
